column4: Watchdog false-positive RESTART LOOP (restarts/hr hit 3). Initial outbound-canary SUSPECT (real or transient) led the watchdog to restart Daisy; each restart killed her in-progress reply mid-turn, which the canary then read as a NEW text_reply_no_send, triggering another restart. Sustained by Daniel actively messaging during the loop (his msgs landed in sessions wiped seconds later, incl a fresh test that never injected). Outbound was NOT actually broken.
column5: Paused watchdog (launchctl unload) to give her a stable session; Daniel sent a clean test (You there?) which injected + she replied + DELIVERED; canary self-cleared to STATUS=OK; doctor HEALTHY cause=none; reloaded watchdog. FOLLOW-UP: watchdog/canary should not count a reply that is still in-progress (or restart while mid-turn) as an outbound drop — that is the loop mechanism.
